Bonfiglioli Transmissions Sets IPO Price Band for ₹2,534 Crore Offering

Bonfiglioli Transmissions Ltd has announced its Initial Public Offering (IPO) price band, setting it between ₹558 and ₹586 per share. The total issue size is valued at ₹2,534 crore. The subscription period for the public will open on October 15 and close on October 19. Anchor investors will have the opportunity to bid on October 14. The IPO is structured as an offer for sale by the promoter, Bonfiglioli SpA.
